title: EgressResult
description: Return shape for every egress channel adapter. All adapters — copy-only stubs and live write-back implementations — emit exactly this shape. schema_version is a hard-cutover field; consumers must reject unknown versions.

schema_version.description: Always '1'. Hard-cutover versioning: a schema_version bump signals a breaking change.

posted.description: True if the message was successfully delivered to the channel. Always false for copy-only stubs and failed adapters.

url.description: Permalink to the posted message. Null for copy-only stubs and failed adapters. Non-null for status 'posted'.

thread_id.description: Channel-specific thread or message identifier. Null for copy-only stubs and failed adapters. Non-null for status 'posted'.

status.description: Outcome of the egress attempt. 'copy-only': stub produced text for manual paste; no write occurred. 'posted': message was delivered and url/thread_id are populated. 'failed': adapter attempted delivery but encountered an error.
